name: CTA L station entries, daily totals
CTA bus routes, daily totals by route
Building permits: renovations that add or mention dwelling units, 2019 on
where: permit_type='PERMIT - RENOVATION/ALTERATION' AND issue_date >= '2019-01-01' AND (upper(work_description) like '%DWELLING%' OR upper(work_description) like '%UNIT%' OR upper(work_description) like '%CONVER%' OR upper(work_description) like '%ADU%' OR upper(work_description) like '%COACH%')

name: 311: potholes, street lights, tree trims since 2023
where: created_date >= '2023-01-01' AND sr_type in ('Pothole in Street Complaint','Street Light Out Complaint','Alley Light Out Complaint','Tree Trim Request','Abandoned Vehicle Complaint','Vacant/Abandoned Building Complaint','Building Violation')
